a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% chance of a storm after every round, so if we both operate in round 1, we most likely both end at 0 and neither survives. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than wait for 8. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now instead of doing it quietly. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round after that, so the reserve can refill for you. If you'd rather settle the 4 cells another way, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. You hadn't seen that message when you planned to operate, and I'm sorry this cuts against our agreement. From now on I'll operate every round to rebuild the reserve, and I won't take anything more. Please take whatever is in the reserve, or operate with me so it grows to 4 for you.
Operating with you. The reserve should reach 2 this round and 4 next round, and all of it is yours. I'll keep operating until you have 4.
